translations.web: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.
translations.bsb: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come— the time of their punishment.
translations.kjv: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
